newsitem.title: USA: Texaco says Calif. crude pipeline to return soon.
newsitem.headline: Texaco says Calif. crude pipeline to return soon.

text.p: Texaco Inc said Friday that a portion of its crude oil pipeline that ruptured Tuesday would be repaired by Friday evening.
"Repairs on the pipeline continue. We have had some delays because of heavy rain, but we anticipate the pipeline will be repaired by this evening," a company spokeswoman said.
The 20-inch portion was originally expected to come back on line Thursday.
Bay area refiners have not been affected, the spokeswoman said.
Early Tuesday, a 50-mile portion of the line shut automatically and spilled about 1,000 barrels of heavy crude from San Joaquin Valley oilfields in California.
The entire line has a daily throughput of 340,000 barrels per day. The shut portion carries 120,000 bpd.
